screenshots.title: 两种入口，清晰开始
screenshots.caption: 从照片新建场景，或导入已经完成的重建。首页只保留这两个入口。

screenshots.title: Two ways to begin
screenshots.caption: Create a scene from photos, or import an existing reconstruction. The home screen keeps both paths easy to find.

screenshots.title: 为场景命名，加入照片
screenshots.caption: 这次演示使用 Teatime 图片集。场景名称会沿用到后续的保存与导出流程。

screenshots.title: Name the scene. Add photos.
screenshots.caption: This walkthrough uses the Teatime image set. The scene name carries through to saving and export.

screenshots.title: 让照片决定下一步
screenshots.caption: 本次读入 177 张照片，177 张独立照片，连接度预检为 97%，App 建议直接重建。连接度是照片重叠的预检指标；相机位姿在后续重建中求解。

screenshots.title: Let the photos guide the next step
screenshots.caption: The App checks 177 photos, finds 177 unique images and reports 97% photo connectivity. It recommends standard reconstruction. Connectivity is an overlap precheck; camera poses are solved during reconstruction.

screenshots.title: 六张照片，按需进入稀疏流程
screenshots.caption: 导入真实的 6 张 Teatime 照片后，App 检测到重叠并建议稀疏重建，同时允许按需补全。此页验证输入判断；本次新训练的展示模型来自完整 177 张照片。

screenshots.title: Six photos trigger the sparse workflow
screenshots.caption: With six real Teatime photos, the App detects overlap and recommends sparse reconstruction with optional completion. This verifies input routing; the newly trained showcase model uses all 177 photos.

screenshots.title: 只有两个视角时，提示补全
screenshots.caption: 导入两张照片后，App 建议稀疏重建并补全，也提醒看不到的背面可能缺失。本图验证自动建议与选择入口，没有将未知背面描述为已恢复的真实几何。

screenshots.title: Two views prompt completion
screenshots.caption: With two photos, the App recommends sparse reconstruction with completion and explains that unseen backsides may remain missing. This captures the automatic recommendation and choice, not a verified recovery of hidden geometry.

screenshots.title: 自己的照片也可以作为输入
screenshots.caption: 已知拍摄覆盖角度时可以填写，并可导入与照片匹配的标定内参。相机位姿由照片求解；数量与连接度预检不等同于已经恢复精确拍摄角度。

screenshots.title: Bring photos from your own camera
screenshots.caption: Optionally provide a known coverage angle and calibrated intrinsics matched to the photos. Camera poses are solved from the images; count and connectivity checks do not establish precise shooting angles.

screenshots.title: 按需要加入物品识别
screenshots.caption: 只想查看场景外观，可以选择普通重建；需要按物品查找和编辑，则开启语义功能。

screenshots.title: Add object understanding when needed
screenshots.caption: Choose appearance-only reconstruction for visual exploration, or enable semantics for finding and editing objects.

screenshots.title: 告诉 App，哪些物品更重要
screenshots.caption: 本次输入“熊、咖啡杯”。这些名称用于匹配照片中的真实区域，核对区域后才能用于重点训练。切换界面语言会保留用户原始输入。

screenshots.title: Tell the App what matters
screenshots.caption: This demo requests the bear and coffee mug. Their names are matched to real image regions, which are reviewed before priority training. Switching languages preserves the original user input.

screenshots.title: 直接在照片上标出重要物品
screenshots.caption: 在 6 张照片示例中，沿熊的可见上身绘制 35 个顶点，并实际保存掩码。名称、跨视角 ID 与层级用于组织标注；同一实例仍需要其他视角的证据。

screenshots.title: Mark the object directly in a photo
screenshots.caption: In the six-photo example, 35 vertices outline the visible upper body of the bear, and the mask is saved. A name, cross-view ID and level organize the annotation; matching the same instance still requires other views.

screenshots.title: 核对实际区域，再用于重点训练
screenshots.caption: 绿色覆盖对应刚刚保存的手工区域，确认后才进入任务。图中的 100% 是手工标注的记录分数，不代表分割准确率。真实 A100 训练另外核对了 28 个候选，保留 11 个区域。

screenshots.title: Review the region before priority training
screenshots.caption: The green overlay is the manually saved region. Confirmation includes it in the task. Its 100% score is a manual-annotation field, not measured accuracy. The separate A100 run reviewed 28 candidates and retained 11.

screenshots.title: 选择效果与计算设备
screenshots.caption: 此次实际任务选择快速模式和 Colab A100：7,000 步 RGB 训练，语义基础预算 400 步、最多抽取 12 个视角；重点细化使用最后 400 步预算。

screenshots.title: Choose quality and compute
screenshots.caption: This run uses Fast mode on a Colab A100: 7,000 RGB iterations, a base semantic budget of 400 steps over up to 12 sampled views, and the final 400 RGB steps reserved for priority detail.

screenshots.title: 开始前，核对时间和配置
screenshots.caption: 确认页展示场景、照片数量、模式、设备和预估耗时。本次页面估算为 8–27 分钟；实际执行耗时单独记录。

screenshots.title: Review the plan before starting
screenshots.caption: The confirmation screen summarizes the scene, photo count, mode, device and estimated duration. It estimates 8–27 minutes here; actual execution time is recorded separately.

screenshots.title: 没有 GPU 服务器，也能使用 Colab
screenshots.caption: App 内置 Colab 配置说明，通过任务 ZIP 与结果文件完成云端交换。这次演示在真实 A100 环境中执行。

screenshots.title: Use Colab without owning a GPU server
screenshots.caption: Built-in instructions explain Colab setup and task/result file exchange. This demo executes in a real A100 environment.

screenshots.title: 本地 NVIDIA 环境有对应指引
screenshots.caption: 用户可以查看 Windows / Linux 的本地 CUDA 训练配置步骤。这里展示的是 App 内的配置说明。

screenshots.title: Local NVIDIA setup is documented
screenshots.caption: Users can open the Windows / Linux CUDA setup instructions inside the App. This screenshot demonstrates the built-in guide.

screenshots.title: 也可以连接自己的云端工作流
screenshots.caption: 其他云服务器同样使用任务包执行方式。依赖安装、任务启动与结果导回步骤集中在 App 内的说明中。

screenshots.title: Bring your own cloud workflow
screenshots.caption: Other GPU servers use the same task-package workflow. Dependency setup, task execution and result import are explained in the App.

screenshots.title: 任务带着照片和设置交给云端
screenshots.caption: 六照片示例已实际导出任务 ZIP，包含确认的重点区域。按包内说明在云端执行，再回到 App 导入结果。这一示例停在任务准备阶段，页面明确显示尚未训练。

screenshots.title: Transfer photos and settings to the cloud
screenshots.caption: The six-photo example exports a task ZIP with its confirmed priority region. Run it using the included instructions, then import the result. This example stops at preparation; the App explicitly shows that training has not started.

screenshots.title: 已有成果，直接打开
screenshots.caption: 导入时先选择场景是否包含物品语义。只有外观的模型同样可以进入三维浏览；语义模型还能按物品进行操作。

screenshots.title: Open an existing result
screenshots.caption: Choose whether the imported scene includes object semantics. Appearance-only models support 3D exploration; semantic scenes also support object-based interaction.

screenshots.title: 让高斯与语义正确配对
screenshots.caption: 本次导入真实训练得到的 point_cloud.ply 和配套 semantics.zip。App 校验模型与语义的对应关系，再打开完整场景。

screenshots.title: Pair geometry with its semantics
screenshots.caption: This demo imports the trained point_cloud.ply and its matching semantics.zip. The App validates their correspondence before opening the complete scene.

screenshots.title: 打开真实训练的 Teatime
screenshots.caption: 177 张照片在 A100 上完成快速训练。完整模型包含 1,200,686 个高斯和三阶球谐；核心区域筛选只影响显示。拖拽旋转、滚轮缩放、右键平移。

screenshots.title: Explore the trained Teatime scene
screenshots.caption: A real Fast run on A100 turns 177 photos into 1,200,686 Gaussians with degree-three spherical harmonics. Core-region filtering changes visibility only. Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, and right-drag to pan.

screenshots.title: 搜索物品，查看区域置信度
screenshots.caption: 输入 table 筛选语义目录，选中区域显示 14,543 个高斯和 52% 跨视角置信度。该数值是匹配权重；此次区域只覆盖桌面的一部分。

screenshots.title: Search objects and inspect confidence
screenshots.caption: Searching for table filters the semantic catalog. This selected region contains 14,543 Gaussians with 52% cross-view confidence. The score is a matching weight; this region covers part of the table.

screenshots.title: 隐藏与撤销，保留原始数据
screenshots.caption: 隐藏选中的语义区域后，其对应高斯从画面中消失。已验证撤销恢复；隐藏不会删除源文件，也不会自动填补露出的空洞。

screenshots.title: Hide a region and keep the source
screenshots.caption: Hiding the selected semantic region removes its Gaussians from view. Undo restoration was verified. Hiding retains the source file and does not automatically fill exposed gaps.

screenshots.title: 一句指令，恢复场景
screenshots.caption: 输入 undo，App 执行本地文字指令并恢复被隔离的场景。已验证文字撤销；界面也提供查找、定位、隐藏等指令入口。

screenshots.title: Restore the scene with a command
screenshots.caption: Typing undo runs a local text command and restores the isolated scene. Text-based undo was verified; the command bar also supports finding, focusing and hiding regions.

screenshots.title: 隔离区域，检查语义覆盖
screenshots.caption: 隔离选中的桌面区域，直接检查当前训练覆盖了哪些高斯。快速版的覆盖仍有空缺；这张实测截图展示区域隔离操作。

screenshots.title: Isolate a region to inspect coverage
screenshots.caption: Isolate the selected table region to inspect its assigned Gaussians. Coverage in this Fast result is incomplete; this measured view demonstrates region isolation.

screenshots.title: 保存完整场景，继续使用
screenshots.caption: 原生 App 已实际导出完整 .splat.jsonl，包含所有高斯、球谐系数、已有语义和当前显示设置。此处将文件命名为 Teatime-Fast；保存窗口的系统按钮跟随 macOS 语言。

screenshots.title: Save a complete, reusable scene
screenshots.caption: The native App exported a complete .splat.jsonl with all Gaussians, spherical harmonics, available semantics and visibility settings. The file is named Teatime-Fast here. System dialog buttons follow the macOS language.
